name: Medium Aquamarine
lede: Medium Aquamarine is a soft sea-green from the named colors of the web.

sections.title: A web color
sections.body:
Paterson gives MediumAquamarine as an entry of the X11 Color Set (140 colours in all), hex code #66CDAA [1]. It belongs to a run of "Medium" names there: MediumBlue, MediumOrchid, MediumPurple, MediumSeaGreen, MediumSlateBlue, MediumSpringGreen, MediumTurquoise and MediumVioletRed [1]. The word has an unrelated meaning in painting, where Paterson defines a medium as the liquid or binder that carries pigment [1].

The gem aquamarine gave the family its first name, but the web color is a screen value, not a stone. Wikipedia lists an alternate hex, #66DDAA, for the name [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Only 2 of 23,781 paintings in our archive cover at least 5% of their canvas with this color, as photographed [3]. One is an anonymous *Aurora* (about 1825), about 10%, and the other a Degas backstage scene (1879), about 8% [3]. Its nearest standard name is [[turquoise]], 8.8 ΔE away [2]. Related names: [[aquamarine]], [[medium-turquoise]] and [[medium-blue]].
